health.title: Health
health.lead: Check that everything on this computer works, see what happened lately, and practise for an emergency.
health.check.title: Full check
health.check.working: Checking this computer … this takes up to a minute.
health.events.title: Recent events
health.events.cut: Some older events were left out because the list was too long.
health.drill.title: Practice drill
health.drill.what: The drill tests, without the internet, everything you would need in an emergency: the brains, the library, maps, speech and the manuals.
health.drill.confirm1: It takes about 2 minutes, sometimes more. You can stop it at any time.
health.drill.confirm2: During the drill the brains are loaded one by one, so a chat may pause. The internet stays connected, but Local AI does not use it while the drill runs.
health.drill.confirm3: When it ends, everything is put back as it was.
health.drill.survival: Not available in survival mode: a drill never disturbs an emergency.
health.drill.running: The drill is running: {n} checks done so far.
health.drill.stopping: Stopping … putting everything back as it was.
health.drill.none: No practice drill has run on this computer yet.
health.out.pass: ✓ Passed. Everything needed in an emergency works.
health.out.warn: ! Passed with warnings. It works, but some things need attention.
health.out.fail: ✗ Failed. Something needed in an emergency does not work.
health.out.aborted: The drill was stopped before it ended. Everything was put back as it was.
health.out.manual_pass: ✓ A "pull the plug" drill was recorded as passed.
health.out.manual_fail: ✗ A "pull the plug" drill was recorded as failed.
health.drl.rebuild: The AI engine could be rebuilt
health.drl.restore: Everything put back as it was
